description: This file defines the HomeDashboardScreen widget, which builds the main dashboard UI for a smart TV weather and fitness application. It arranges various UI components such as weather cards, forecast rows, and a fitness carousel within a scrollable layout.

classes.name: HomeDashboardScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that constructs the main dashboard screen combining weather and fitness sections.

classes.name: _NoGlowBehavior
classes.description: A custom ScrollBehavior that disables the overscroll glow effect.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the dashboard, including app bar, weather cards, forecast, and fitness carousel.
